title: Rohan's car loan vs Sharma's building loan 🏢
description:
Why do the rich love debt while everyone else is scared of it?
Two loans: a $40,000 car at an assumed 8% that loses value, and $100,000 for something that grows at an assumed 8% a year while the loan costs an assumed 6%. Every figure computed. Returns and rates are assumptions, not promises; borrowing to buy anything can lose money. Speak to a licensed financial adviser in your country before making financial decisions.
An animated story with illustrative numbers; the characters are not advisers.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
